news.analysis: CRod was dealing with injuries heading into this week, so it's not surprising to see him get a reduced workload. What was surprising was his total lack of efficiency on those limited touches. He had a long gain of six yards, which means that his other three carries totaled for -1 yard. It's a tough break after a decent performance against the Ravens ten days ago, and he will look to have a better outing next time out against the Giants.
